title: Q-FIND-what-works: make https://what-works.ultrastable.org/ findable (1 gaps)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** findable workflow, daily
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation findable --probe what-works
**Prediction:** findable_gaps <= 0 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** paid listings, new accounts, and any page that is not this property's own
**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation findable --probe what-works
**Status:** closed

https://what-works.ultrastable.org/ is missing what search engines and AI agents read: no llms.txt. Fix the property's own pages (shared seed modules first, so every system gets it). Closed by the same daily reading.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:01:50Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
